title: fix: hook tiers, lead state, ci-fix and open feature pushes
headline: A hook that crashes answers by its tier, the lead works from a checked state record, a red CI run is cleared only through ci-fix, feature pushes no longer ask while CI guards each test, and only a broken safety net pauses a sweep.
alignment: v1.51.4 is the patch planned after v1.51.3: the 15 rows of the 11-22 triage and the 11-23 checks, built as 28 units and 7 retests.

decisions.decision: A finish line for the ci-fix review loop
decisions.why: After 15 narrowing review rounds, only a high or critical finding or a bypass by ordinary edits lands here; the rest go to the next list. The owner's pick (2026-11-24).

decisions.decision: A ci-fix grant carries its pop-up proof
decisions.why: CI cannot read the pop-up, so the fix line carries the proof, checked for consistency in CI and read live where the session is readable. The owner's pick (2026-11-24).
CI now judges every commit against its parent, so the push hold moved to a check that cannot be skipped; main, tags, force and deletes keep the yes.

upgrading: Run install user, then install project: the new tools `lead-state.mjs`, `side-job.mjs` and `ci-fix.mjs`, the hooks `hook-error.cjs` and `ci-fix.cjs` with the tiers in holds.json, and the changed sweep approver, plan-check, guards and pre-push hook come with them.
limits: The ci-fix hold stops slips, not forgery by someone with the user's own file access; review findings past the finish line are rows on the next list. The pre-commit secret scan runs in the kit source only.
